title: lotus repens
intro: Lotus repens, commonly known as lotus root or lilyturf, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Asphodelaceae. The health benefits of lotus repens include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and aid in weight management due to its high fiber and water content. The therapeutic actions of lotus repens are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of lotus repens include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
